summary.modality_context: EGFR has documented KINASE-INDEPENDENT pro-survival functions (glucose transporter stabilization, autophagy modulation) beyond its catalytic activity, so full removal (degrader / antibody-mediated downregulation) can differ from TKI inhibition in some contexts.
